title: Remove dead ProfileDao import in user_database_managers_test.dart:12
why: `ProfileDao` (a DatabaseAccessor class, not an extension) is never referenced anywhere in the 1073-line file. `unused_import` is absent from analysis_options.yaml's hand-rolled lint list (confirmed by grep), so `flutter analyze` — clean in the audit baseline — does not and will not catch this or future dead imports in this file.
recommendation: Delete the import. Separately, consider adding `unused_import` to the explicit lint list so this class of defect gets a Rule-0 checker.
